value.rationale: This determines a natural fixed-two-area affine-constrained subfamily of the emerging theta-convolution extremal problem. The optimal geometry switches universally at theta=1/2, with homothetic minimizers below, one-shared-edge minimizers above, a full critical equality manifold, and a strictly negative explicit cusp. It is not merely the elementary tent-product computation or a routine corollary of general global bounds.
